yacl3.config.minecraft:stackedactionbarm: Whether to enable the mod or not.
How many actionbar messages can be shown at once.

Some servers send very similar messages frequently (e.g. timers). The mod doesn't push messages it recognizes as similar onto the stack.
This setting controls how sensitive the similarity scoring is. A setting of 100% requires an exact match for two messages to be considered similar. 0% treats every message as similar.
Restrict stacking to a whitelist or blacklist of servers.
Server addresses (host or host:port) used by the whitelist or blacklist.
